scene.zh: 一位女士在辦公室的桌前用筆電打字，旁邊有一個咖啡杯。
scene.en: A woman in an office typing on a laptop at a desk, a coffee mug beside the laptop.
scene.zh-Hans: 一位女士在办公室的桌前用笔电打字，旁边有一个咖啡杯。

t: Number one. Look at the picture.
lines.plain: Number one. Look at the picture.
lines.kana: Number one. Look at the picture.
lines.zh: 第 1 題。請看照片。
lines.en: Number one. Look at the picture.
lines.zh-Hans: 第 1 题。请看照片。

t: She's pouring a cup of coffee.
options.plain: She's pouring a cup of coffee.
options.kana: She's pouring a cup of coffee.
options.en: She's pouring a cup of coffee.

explain.zh: 照片中她在桌前「用筆電打字」；咖啡杯只是放在旁邊，她沒有在倒咖啡。
explain.en: She is typing; the mug is just on the desk.
explain.zh-Hans: 照片中她在桌前「用笔电打字」；咖啡杯只是放在旁边，她没有在倒咖啡。

scene.zh: 兩位男士一起把一張長木桌搬過空房間。
scene.en: Two men carrying a long wooden table together across an empty room.
scene.zh-Hans: 两位男士一起把一张长木桌搬过空房间。

t: Number two. Look at the picture.
lines.plain: Number two. Look at the picture.
lines.kana: Number two. Look at the picture.
lines.zh: 第 2 題。請看照片。
lines.en: Number two. Look at the picture.
lines.zh-Hans: 第 2 题。请看照片。

t: They're setting the table for dinner.
options.plain: They're setting the table for dinner.
options.kana: They're setting the table for dinner.
options.zh: 他們正在擺餐桌準備晚餐。
options.en: They're setting the table for dinner.
options.zh-Hans: 他们正在摆餐桌准备晚餐。

explain.zh: 兩人「正在搬桌子」。(D) 也提到桌子，但他們不是坐著。
explain.en: They are carrying it, not sitting at it.
explain.zh-Hans: 两人「正在搬桌子」。(D) 也提到桌子，但他们不是坐着。

scene.zh: 腳踏車沿著人行道上的金屬欄杆整齊停成一排，沒有人。
scene.en: Bicycles parked in a neat row along a metal railing on a city sidewalk, with no people.
scene.zh-Hans: 自行车沿着人行道上的金属栏杆整齐停成一排，没有人。

t: Number three. Look at the picture.
lines.plain: Number three. Look at the picture.
lines.kana: Number three. Look at the picture.
lines.zh: 第 3 題。請看照片。
lines.en: Number three. Look at the picture.
lines.zh-Hans: 第 3 题。请看照片。

t: Bicycles have been parked in a row.
options.plain: Bicycles have been parked in a row.
options.kana: Bicycles have been parked in a row.
options.en: Bicycles have been parked in a row.

t: A sidewalk is crowded with shoppers.
options.plain: A sidewalk is crowded with shoppers.
options.kana: A sidewalk is crowded with shoppers.
options.zh: 人行道上擠滿了購物的人。
options.en: A sidewalk is crowded with shoppers.
options.zh-Hans: 人行道上挤满了购物的人。

explain.zh: 照片裡沒有人，只有「停成一排的腳踏車」。沒有人的照片常用 have been + 過去分詞描述狀態。
explain.en: No people: the bikes have been parked in a row.
explain.zh-Hans: 照片里没有人，只有「停成一排的自行车」。没有人的照片常用 have been + 过去分词描述状态。

scene.zh: 一位男士在溫室裡用水管幫植物澆水。
scene.en: A man watering plants in a greenhouse with a garden hose.
scene.zh-Hans: 一位男士在温室里用水管帮植物浇水。

t: Number four. Look at the picture.
lines.plain: Number four. Look at the picture.
lines.kana: Number four. Look at the picture.
lines.zh: 第 4 題。請看照片。
lines.en: Number four. Look at the picture.
lines.zh-Hans: 第 4 题。请看照片。

t: He's planting a tree in a field.
options.plain: He's planting a tree in a field.
options.kana: He's planting a tree in a field.
options.en: He's planting a tree in a field.

options.zh: 他正在幫一些植物澆水。
options.zh-Hans: 他正在帮一些植物浇水。

explain.zh: 他拿著水管「幫植物澆水」。(C) 洗車也會用到水管，是陷阱。
explain.en: He is watering plants; the hose is a trap for (C).
explain.zh-Hans: 他拿着水管「帮植物浇水」。(C) 洗车也会用到水管，是陷阱。

scene.zh: 一位女士在超市結帳台把卡片遞給收銀員，台上放著買的東西。
scene.en: A woman at a supermarket checkout handing a payment card to a cashier, groceries on the counter.
scene.zh-Hans: 一位女士在超市结帐台把卡片递给收银员，台上放着买的东西。

t: Number five. Look at the picture.
lines.plain: Number five. Look at the picture.
lines.kana: Number five. Look at the picture.
lines.zh: 第 5 題。請看照片。
lines.en: Number five. Look at the picture.
lines.zh-Hans: 第 5 题。请看照片。

t: A woman is paying for her groceries.
options.plain: A woman is paying for her groceries.
options.kana: A woman is paying for her groceries.
options.zh: 一位女士正在為買的東西付錢。
options.en: A woman is paying for her groceries.
options.zh-Hans: 一位女士正在为买的东西付钱。

options.zh: 收銀員正在把商品排上貨架。
options.zh-Hans: 收银员正在把商品排上货架。

t: A woman is pushing a cart outside.
options.plain: A woman is pushing a cart outside.
options.kana: A woman is pushing a cart outside.
options.zh: 一位女士正在外面推購物車。
options.en: A woman is pushing a cart outside.
options.zh-Hans: 一位女士正在外面推购物车。

t: Some bags are being loaded into a car.
options.plain: Some bags are being loaded into a car.
options.kana: Some bags are being loaded into a car.
options.zh: 有些袋子正被放進車裡。
options.en: Some bags are being loaded into a car.
options.zh-Hans: 有些袋子正被放进车里。

explain.zh: 她正把卡遞給收銀員，也就是「在付錢」。
explain.en: She is handing her card to the cashier: paying.
explain.zh-Hans: 她正把卡递给收银员，也就是「在付钱」。

scene.zh: 一間沒有人的會議室，椅子圍著長桌排好，牆上有投影幕。
scene.en: An empty meeting room with chairs arranged around a long table and a projector screen on the wall, no people.
scene.zh-Hans: 一间没有人的会议室，椅子围着长桌排好，墙上有投影幕。

t: Number six. Look at the picture.
lines.plain: Number six. Look at the picture.
lines.kana: Number six. Look at the picture.
lines.zh: 第 6 題。請看照片。
lines.en: Number six. Look at the picture.
lines.zh-Hans: 第 6 题。请看照片。

t: The chairs are stacked in a corner.
options.plain: The chairs are stacked in a corner.
options.kana: The chairs are stacked in a corner.
options.en: The chairs are stacked in a corner.

t: Chairs have been arranged around a table.
options.plain: Chairs have been arranged around a table.
options.kana: Chairs have been arranged around a table.
options.zh: 椅子已經圍著桌子排好了。
options.en: Chairs have been arranged around a table.
options.zh-Hans: 椅子已经围着桌子排好了。

t: A man is adjusting a screen.
options.plain: A man is adjusting a screen.
options.kana: A man is adjusting a screen.
options.zh: 一位男士正在調整螢幕。
options.en: A man is adjusting a screen.
options.zh-Hans: 一位男士正在调整屏幕。

explain.zh: 會議室裡沒有人，椅子「圍著桌子排好」。(B)(D) 都需要有人在場。
explain.en: No people, so (B) and (D) are out; the chairs are around the table.
explain.zh-Hans: 会议室里没有人，椅子「围着桌子排好」。(B)(D) 都需要有人在场。

t: Where should I put these boxes?
lines.plain: Where should I put these boxes?
lines.kana: Where should I put these boxes?
lines.zh: 這些箱子要放在哪裡？
lines.en: Where should I put these boxes?
lines.zh-Hans: 这些箱子要放在哪里？

explain.zh: 問「哪裡」，答地點「印表機旁邊」。Where 開頭的問題不能用 Yes 回答。
explain.en: A "where" question: a place, never "yes".
explain.zh-Hans: 问「哪里」，答地点「打印机旁边」。Where 开头的问题不能用 Yes 回答。

t: When does the training session start?
lines.plain: When does the training session start?
lines.kana: When does the training session start?
lines.zh: 訓練課程什麼時候開始？
lines.en: When does the training session start?
lines.zh-Hans: 训练课程什么时候开始？

explain.zh: 問「什麼時候」，答時間「明天九點半」。(A) 是回答地點。
explain.en: A "when" question: a time.
explain.zh-Hans: 问「什么时候」，答时间「明天九点半」。(A) 是回答地点。

t: Who's taking notes at today's meeting?
lines.plain: Who's taking notes at today's meeting?
lines.kana: Who's taking notes at today's meeting?
lines.zh: 今天的會議誰做紀錄？
lines.en: Who's taking notes at today's meeting?
lines.zh-Hans: 今天的会议谁做纪录？

explain.zh: 問「誰」，答人「瑪莉亞」。(B) 用 notes 聯想到筆記本，是陷阱。
explain.en: A "who" question: Maria.
explain.zh-Hans: 问「谁」，答人「玛莉亚」。(B) 用 notes 联想到笔记本，是陷阱。

t: Would you like me to book a taxi for you?
lines.plain: Would you like me to book a taxi for you?
lines.kana: Would you like me to book a taxi for you?
lines.zh: 要我幫你叫計程車嗎？
lines.en: Would you like me to book a taxi for you?
lines.zh-Hans: 要我帮你叫出租车吗？

explain.zh: 對方提議幫忙，接受並道謝最自然。(C) 用 book 的另一個意思「書」來混淆。
explain.en: Accepting the offer; (C) plays on "book".
explain.zh-Hans: 对方提议帮忙，接受并道谢最自然。(C) 用 book 的另一个意思「书」来混淆。

t: Why was the delivery late this morning?
lines.plain: Why was the delivery late this morning?
lines.kana: Why was the delivery late this morning?
lines.zh: 今天早上的貨為什麼晚到？
lines.en: Why was the delivery late this morning?
lines.zh-Hans: 今天早上的货为什么晚到？

t: There was an accident on the highway.
options.plain: There was an accident on the highway.
options.kana: There was an accident on the highway.
options.zh: 高速公路上發生了車禍。
options.en: There was an accident on the highway.
options.zh-Hans: 高速公路上发生了车祸。

explain.zh: 問「為什麼」，答原因「高速公路上有車禍」。
explain.en: A "why" question: the reason.
explain.zh-Hans: 问「为什么」，答原因「高速公路上有车祸」。

t: You've worked here for a long time, haven't you?
lines.plain: You've worked here for a long time, haven't you?
lines.kana: You've worked here for a long time, haven't you?
lines.zh: 你在這裡工作很久了，對吧？
lines.en: You've worked here for a long time, haven't you?
lines.zh-Hans: 你在这里工作很久了，对吧？

explain.zh: 附加問句確認「工作很久了吧」，回答年資最自然。
explain.en: A tag question; he gives how long.
explain.zh-Hans: 附加问句确认「工作很久了吧」，回答年资最自然。

t: Should we order lunch or go out?
lines.plain: Should we order lunch or go out?
lines.kana: Should we order lunch or go out?
lines.zh: 我們要叫午餐外送還是出去吃？
lines.en: Should we order lunch or go out?
lines.zh-Hans: 我们要叫午餐外送还是出去吃？

t: Let's eat at the café downstairs.
options.plain: Let's eat at the café downstairs.
options.kana: Let's eat at the café downstairs.
options.zh: 我們去樓下的咖啡店吃吧。
options.en: Let's eat at the café downstairs.
options.zh-Hans: 我们去楼下的咖啡店吃吧。

t: He went out an hour ago.
options.plain: He went out an hour ago.
options.kana: He went out an hour ago.
options.en: He went out an hour ago.

explain.zh: 二選一的問題不能用 Yes 回答；「去樓下咖啡店吃」就是選了出去吃。
explain.en: A choice question: she picks going out.
explain.zh-Hans: 二选一的问题不能用 Yes 回答；「去楼下咖啡店吃」就是选了出去吃。

t: The copier on the third floor isn't working.
lines.plain: The copier on the third floor isn't working.
lines.kana: The copier on the third floor isn't working.
lines.zh: 三樓的影印機壞了。
lines.en: The copier on the third floor isn't working.
lines.zh-Hans: 三楼的复印机坏了。

explain.zh: 對方說機器壞了，回應「我來叫維修人員」最合適。(C) 只是重複 third floor。
explain.en: He offers to call the technician; (C) only repeats words.
explain.zh-Hans: 对方说机器坏了，回应「我来叫维修人员」最合适。(C) 只是重复 third floor。

lines.plain: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.kana: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.zh: 請聽以下對話。
lines.en: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下对话。

t: Hi, Daniel. I'm putting together this month's order for office supplies. Do we need anything for the design team?
lines.plain: Hi, Daniel. I'm putting together this month's order for office supplies. Do we need anything for the design team?
lines.kana: Hi, Daniel. I'm putting together this month's order for office supplies. Do we need anything for the design team?
lines.zh: 嗨，丹尼爾。我正在整理這個月的辦公用品訂單。設計組需要什麼嗎？
lines.en: Hi, Daniel. I'm putting together this month's order for office supplies. Do we need anything for the design team?
lines.zh-Hans: 嗨，丹尼尔。我正在整理这个月的办公用品订单。设计组需要什么吗？

t: Actually, yes. We're almost out of printer ink, and a couple of people have asked for larger monitors.
lines.plain: Actually, yes. We're almost out of printer ink, and a couple of people have asked for larger monitors.
lines.kana: Actually, yes. We're almost out of printer ink, and a couple of people have asked for larger monitors.
lines.zh: 其實有。印表機墨水快用完了，還有幾個人想要大一點的螢幕。
lines.en: Actually, yes. We're almost out of printer ink, and a couple of people have asked for larger monitors.
lines.zh-Hans: 其实有。打印机墨水快用完了，还有几个人想要大一点的屏幕。

t: Ink is no problem, but monitors are expensive. I'd need approval from the finance department for those.
lines.plain: Ink is no problem, but monitors are expensive. I'd need approval from the finance department for those.
lines.kana: Ink is no problem, but monitors are expensive. I'd need approval from the finance department for those.
lines.zh: 墨水沒問題，可是螢幕很貴，要財務部核准才行。
lines.en: Ink is no problem, but monitors are expensive. I'd need approval from the finance department for those.
lines.zh-Hans: 墨水没问题，可是屏幕很贵，要财务部核准才行。

t: I understand. I'll send you an e-mail with exactly how many we need, and you can forward it to them.
lines.plain: I understand. I'll send you an e-mail with exactly how many we need, and you can forward it to them.
lines.kana: I understand. I'll send you an e-mail with exactly how many we need, and you can forward it to them.
lines.zh: 了解。我會寄電子郵件告訴你確切需要幾台，你再轉給他們。
lines.en: I understand. I'll send you an e-mail with exactly how many we need, and you can forward it to them.
lines.zh-Hans: 了解。我会寄电子邮件告诉你确切需要几台，你再转给他们。

ask.plain: What is the woman doing?
ask.en: What is the woman doing?

explain.zh: 她說「我正在整理這個月的辦公用品訂單」。
explain.en: She is putting together the supplies order.
explain.zh-Hans: 她说「我正在整理这个月的办公用品订单」。

t: What does the woman say about the monitors?
ask.plain: What does the woman say about the monitors?
ask.zh: 關於螢幕，女的說了什麼？
ask.en: What does the woman say about the monitors?
ask.zh-Hans: 关于屏幕，女的说了什么？

explain.zh: 螢幕很貴，「要財務部核准」。
explain.en: She needs the finance department's approval.
explain.zh-Hans: 屏幕很贵，「要财务部核准」。

t: What will the man do next?
ask.plain: What will the man do next?
ask.en: What will the man do next?

explain.zh: 「我會寄電子郵件告訴你需要幾台」。
explain.en: He will e-mail her the numbers.
explain.zh-Hans: 「我会寄电子邮件告诉你需要几台」。

lines.plain: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.kana: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.zh: 請聽以下對話。
lines.en: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下对话。

t: Good afternoon, Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
lines.plain: Good afternoon, Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
lines.kana: Good afternoon, Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 午安，港景飯店，請問有什麼需要？
lines.en: Good afternoon, Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
lines.zh-Hans: 午安，港景饭店，请问有什么需要？

t: Hello. I have a reservation for three nights starting on Thursday, but my flight's been changed. Could I arrive on Friday instead?
lines.plain: Hello. I have a reservation for three nights starting on Thursday, but my flight's been changed. Could I arrive on Friday instead?
lines.kana: Hello. I have a reservation for three nights starting on Thursday, but my flight's been changed. Could I arrive on Friday instead?
lines.zh: 你好。我訂了從星期四開始住三晚，可是我的班機改了。可以改成星期五入住嗎？
lines.en: Hello. I have a reservation for three nights starting on Thursday, but my flight's been changed. Could I arrive on Friday instead?
lines.zh-Hans: 你好。我订了从星期四开始住三晚，可是我的班机改了。可以改成星期五入住吗？

t: Let me check. Yes, we can move your booking. However, the rate for Friday and Saturday nights is a little higher. It's twenty dollars more per night.
lines.plain: Let me check. Yes, we can move your booking. However, the rate for Friday and Saturday nights is a little higher. It's twenty dollars more per night.
lines.kana: Let me check. Yes, we can move your booking. However, the rate for Friday and Saturday nights is a little higher. It's twenty dollars more per night.
lines.zh: 我查一下。可以，我們能幫您改。不過星期五和星期六晚上的房價高一點，每晚多二十美元。
lines.en: Let me check. Yes, we can move your booking. However, the rate for Friday and Saturday nights is a little higher. It's twenty dollars more per night.
lines.zh-Hans: 我查一下。可以，我们能帮您改。不过星期五和星期六晚上的房价高一点，每晚多二十美元。

t: That's fine. And could you tell me whether breakfast is included?
lines.plain: That's fine. And could you tell me whether breakfast is included?
lines.kana: That's fine. And could you tell me whether breakfast is included?
lines.zh: 沒關係。另外可以告訴我有沒有含早餐嗎？
lines.en: That's fine. And could you tell me whether breakfast is included?
lines.zh-Hans: 没关系。另外可以告诉我有没有含早餐吗？

t: It is. It's served in the restaurant on the ground floor from six thirty to ten.
lines.plain: It is. It's served in the restaurant on the ground floor from six thirty to ten.
lines.kana: It is. It's served in the restaurant on the ground floor from six thirty to ten.
lines.zh: 有含。早餐在一樓餐廳，從六點半供應到十點。
lines.en: It is. It's served in the restaurant on the ground floor from six thirty to ten.
lines.zh-Hans: 有含。早餐在一楼餐厅，从六点半供应到十点。

ask.plain: Why is the woman calling?
ask.en: Why is the woman calling?
ask.ja: 女性はどうして電話をかけていますか？

explain.zh: 班機改了，問「可以改成星期五入住嗎」。
explain.en: Her flight changed, so she wants to arrive on Friday.
explain.zh-Hans: 班机改了，问「可以改成星期五入住吗」。

t: What does the man say about the new dates?
ask.plain: What does the man say about the new dates?
ask.zh: 關於新的日期，男的說了什麼？
ask.en: What does the man say about the new dates?
ask.zh-Hans: 关于新的日期，男的说了什么？

explain.zh: 週五、週六「每晚多二十美元」。
explain.en: Twenty dollars more per night.
explain.zh-Hans: 周五、周六「每晚多二十美元」。

ask.plain: Where is breakfast served?
ask.en: Where is breakfast served?

t: In a café across the street
options.plain: In a café across the street

explain.zh: 「早餐在一樓餐廳」。
explain.en: In the restaurant on the ground floor.
explain.zh-Hans: 「早餐在一楼餐厅」。

t: Listen to the following conversation with three speakers.
lines.plain: Listen to the following conversation with three speakers.
lines.kana: Listen to the following conversation with three speakers.
lines.zh: 請聽以下三人對話。
lines.en: Listen to the following conversation with three speakers.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下三人对话。

t: Thanks for coming in, both of you. As you know, our second restaurant opens next month, and we still need to decide on the menu.
lines.plain: Thanks for coming in, both of you. As you know, our second restaurant opens next month, and we still need to decide on the menu.
lines.kana: Thanks for coming in, both of you. As you know, our second restaurant opens next month, and we still need to decide on the menu.
lines.zh: 謝謝兩位過來。你們也知道，我們的第二家餐廳下個月開幕，菜單還沒決定。
lines.en: Thanks for coming in, both of you. As you know, our second restaurant opens next month, and we still need to decide on the menu.
lines.zh-Hans: 谢谢两位过来。你们也知道，我们的第二家餐厅下个月开幕，菜单还没决定。

t: I think we should keep it small at first, maybe ten dishes, so the kitchen staff can learn them quickly.
lines.plain: I think we should keep it small at first, maybe ten dishes, so the kitchen staff can learn them quickly.
lines.kana: I think we should keep it small at first, maybe ten dishes, so the kitchen staff can learn them quickly.
lines.zh: 我覺得一開始菜色少一點比較好，大概十道，這樣廚房人員能很快學會。
lines.en: I think we should keep it small at first, maybe ten dishes, so the kitchen staff can learn them quickly.
lines.zh-Hans: 我觉得一开始菜色少一点比较好，大概十道，这样厨房人员能很快学会。

t: I agree with Tom. And we should include a few vegetarian options. A lot of customers have been asking for them.
lines.plain: I agree with Tom. And we should include a few vegetarian options. A lot of customers have been asking for them.
lines.kana: I agree with Tom. And we should include a few vegetarian options. A lot of customers have been asking for them.
lines.zh: 我同意湯姆。而且應該放幾道素食，很多客人一直在問。
lines.en: I agree with Tom. And we should include a few vegetarian options. A lot of customers have been asking for them.
lines.zh-Hans: 我同意汤姆。而且应该放几道素食，很多客人一直在问。

t: Good point, Ken. Could you write up some ideas and bring them to Friday's meeting?
lines.plain: Good point, Ken. Could you write up some ideas and bring them to Friday's meeting?
lines.kana: Good point, Ken. Could you write up some ideas and bring them to Friday's meeting?
lines.zh: 說得好，肯。你可以寫一些點子，帶到星期五的會議嗎？
lines.en: Good point, Ken. Could you write up some ideas and bring them to Friday's meeting?
lines.zh-Hans: 说得好，肯。你可以写一些点子，带到星期五的会议吗？

t: Sure, I'll have them ready by then.
lines.plain: Sure, I'll have them ready by then.
lines.kana: Sure, I'll have them ready by then.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我會在那之前準備好。
lines.en: Sure, I'll have them ready by then.
lines.zh-Hans: 没问题，我会在那之前准备好。

t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
ask.plain: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
ask.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？
ask.en: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
ask.zh-Hans: 说话者主要在讨论什么？

explain.zh: 新餐廳下個月開幕，「菜單還沒決定」。
explain.en: The menu for the second restaurant.
explain.zh-Hans: 新餐厅下个月开幕，「菜单还没决定」。

t: According to Ken, what have customers asked for?
ask.plain: According to Ken, what have customers asked for?
ask.zh: 根據肯的說法，客人一直在要求什麼？
ask.en: According to Ken, what have customers asked for?
ask.zh-Hans: 根据肯的说法，客人一直在要求什么？

explain.zh: 肯說應該放幾道素食，「很多客人一直在問」。
explain.en: Customers keep asking for vegetarian options.
explain.zh-Hans: 肯说应该放几道素食，「很多客人一直在问」。

t: What will Ken do by Friday?
ask.plain: What will Ken do by Friday?
ask.zh: 肯在星期五前會做什麼？
ask.en: What will Ken do by Friday?
ask.zh-Hans: 肯在星期五前会做什么？

explain.zh: 老闆請他「寫一些點子帶到星期五的會議」，他答應了。
explain.en: He will write up ideas for Friday's meeting.
explain.zh-Hans: 老板请他「写一些点子带到星期五的会议」，他答应了。

lines.plain: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.kana: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.zh: 請聽以下對話。
lines.en: Listen to the following conversation.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下对话。

t: Hi, Lisa. Are you all set for your presentation at the conference tomorrow?
lines.plain: Hi, Lisa. Are you all set for your presentation at the conference tomorrow?
lines.kana: Hi, Lisa. Are you all set for your presentation at the conference tomorrow?
lines.zh: 嗨，麗莎。明天研討會的簡報都準備好了嗎？
lines.en: Hi, Lisa. Are you all set for your presentation at the conference tomorrow?
lines.zh-Hans: 嗨，丽莎。明天研讨会的演示文稿都准备好了吗？

t: Almost. I've finished the slides, but my train was just cancelled, so I'm not sure how I'll get to Boston in time.
lines.plain: Almost. I've finished the slides, but my train was just cancelled, so I'm not sure how I'll get to Boston in time.
lines.kana: Almost. I've finished the slides, but my train was just cancelled, so I'm not sure how I'll get to Boston in time.
lines.zh: 差不多了。投影片做完了，可是我的火車剛被取消，不知道要怎麼及時趕到波士頓。
lines.en: Almost. I've finished the slides, but my train was just cancelled, so I'm not sure how I'll get to Boston in time.
lines.zh-Hans: 差不多了。投视频做完了，可是我的火车刚被取消，不知道要怎么及时赶到波士顿。

t: Why don't you ride with me? I'm driving up tonight, and there's plenty of room in the car.
lines.plain: Why don't you ride with me? I'm driving up tonight, and there's plenty of room in the car.
lines.kana: Why don't you ride with me? I'm driving up tonight, and there's plenty of room in the car.
lines.zh: 要不要搭我的車？我今晚開車過去，車上空位很多。
lines.en: Why don't you ride with me? I'm driving up tonight, and there's plenty of room in the car.
lines.zh-Hans: 要不要搭我的车？我今晚开车过去，车上空位很多。

t: Really? That would be a big help. I can pay for the gas.
lines.plain: Really? That would be a big help. I can pay for the gas.
lines.kana: Really? That would be a big help. I can pay for the gas.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？那幫了大忙。油錢我出。
lines.en: Really? That would be a big help. I can pay for the gas.
lines.zh-Hans: 真的吗？那帮了大忙。油钱我出。

t: Don't worry about it. I'll pick you up at your apartment at seven.
lines.plain: Don't worry about it. I'll pick you up at your apartment at seven.
lines.kana: Don't worry about it. I'll pick you up at your apartment at seven.
lines.zh: 不用啦。我七點去你的公寓接你。
lines.en: Don't worry about it. I'll pick you up at your apartment at seven.
lines.zh-Hans: 不用啦。我七点去你的公寓接你。

t: What problem does the woman mention?
ask.plain: What problem does the woman mention?
ask.en: What problem does the woman mention?

explain.zh: 「我的火車剛被取消」。投影片已經做完了。
explain.en: Her train was cancelled; the slides are done.
explain.zh-Hans: 「我的火车刚被取消」。投视频已经做完了。

t: What does the man offer to do?
ask.plain: What does the man offer to do?
ask.en: What does the man offer to do?

explain.zh: 「要不要搭我的車？」
explain.en: He offers her a ride.
explain.zh-Hans: 「要不要搭我的车？」

t: What time will the man pick the woman up?
ask.plain: What time will the man pick the woman up?
ask.en: What time will the man pick the woman up?

explain.zh: 「我七點去你的公寓接你」。
explain.en: At seven.
explain.zh-Hans: 「我七点去你的公寓接你」。

lines.plain: Listen to the following announcement.
lines.kana: Listen to the following announcement.
lines.zh: 請聽以下廣播。
lines.en: Listen to the following announcement.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下广播。

t: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Green Valley Market. This weekend only, all fresh fruit and vegetables are fifteen percent off. And don't forget to visit our bakery at the back of the store, where we're offering free samples of our new whole-grain bread. Also, please note that starting next Monday, the store will open an hour earlier, at seven a.m., so you can shop before work.
lines.plain: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Green Valley Market. This weekend only, all fresh fruit and vegetables are fifteen percent off. And don't forget to visit our bakery at the back of the store, where we're offering free samples of our new whole-grain bread. Also, please note that starting next Monday, the store will open an hour earlier, at seven a.m., so you can shop before work.
lines.kana: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Green Valley Market. This weekend only, all fresh fruit and vegetables are fifteen percent off. And don't forget to visit our bakery at the back of the store, where we're offering free samples of our new whole-grain bread. Also, please note that starting next Monday, the store will open an hour earlier, at seven a.m., so you can shop before work.
lines.zh: 各位顧客請注意。感謝您光臨綠谷超市。僅限本週末，所有新鮮蔬果打八五折。別忘了到店後方的烘焙區，我們的新全麥麵包提供免費試吃。另外請注意，從下週一開始，本店提早一小時、早上七點營業，讓您上班前就能購物。
lines.en: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Green Valley Market. This weekend only, all fresh fruit and vegetables are fifteen percent off. And don't forget to visit our bakery at the back of the store, where we're offering free samples of our new whole-grain bread. Also, please note that starting next Monday, the store will open an hour earlier, at seven a.m., so you can shop before work.
lines.zh-Hans: 各位顾客请注意。感谢您光临绿谷超市。仅限本周末，所有新鲜蔬果打八五折。别忘了到店后方的烘焙区，我们的新全麦面包提供免费试吃。另外请注意，从下周一开始，本店提早一小时、早上七点营业，让您上班前就能购物。

t: Where is the announcement being made?
ask.plain: Where is the announcement being made?
ask.en: Where is the announcement being made?

explain.zh: 「感謝您光臨綠谷超市」，又提到蔬果打折。
explain.en: Green Valley Market, with fruit and vegetables on sale.
explain.zh-Hans: 「感谢您光临绿谷超市」，又提到蔬果打折。

t: What can shoppers get at the bakery?
ask.plain: What can shoppers get at the bakery?
ask.zh: 顧客可以在烘焙區得到什麼？
ask.en: What can shoppers get at the bakery?
ask.zh-Hans: 顾客可以在烘焙区得到什么？

explain.zh: 新的全麥麵包「提供免費試吃」。
explain.en: Free samples of the new bread.
explain.zh-Hans: 新的全麦面包「提供免费试吃」。

ask.plain: What will change next Monday?
ask.en: What will change next Monday?

explain.zh: 「從下週一開始提早一小時、早上七點營業」。
explain.en: It will open an hour earlier, at 7 a.m.
explain.zh-Hans: 「从下周一开始提早一小时、早上七点营业」。

t: Listen to the following telephone message.
lines.plain: Listen to the following telephone message.
lines.kana: Listen to the following telephone message.
lines.zh: 請聽以下電話留言。
lines.en: Listen to the following telephone message.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下电话留言。

t: Hi, this is Mark Chen from Bright Electric. I'm calling about the lights you asked us to install in your office. We've received the parts, so we can do the work this Thursday. It should take about three hours. Since we'll need to turn off the power while we work, you might want to let your staff know in advance. Please call me back to confirm. Thanks.
lines.plain: Hi, this is Mark Chen from Bright Electric. I'm calling about the lights you asked us to install in your office. We've received the parts, so we can do the work this Thursday. It should take about three hours. Since we'll need to turn off the power while we work, you might want to let your staff know in advance. Please call me back to confirm. Thanks.
lines.kana: Hi, this is Mark Chen from Bright Electric. I'm calling about the lights you asked us to install in your office. We've received the parts, so we can do the work this Thursday. It should take about three hours. Since we'll need to turn off the power while we work, you might want to let your staff know in advance. Please call me back to confirm. Thanks.
lines.zh: 你好，我是光亮電氣的陳馬克。我打來是關於您請我們在辦公室安裝的燈具。零件已經到了，所以這個星期四可以施工，大約需要三個小時。因為施工時要切斷電源，您可能要先通知員工。請回電確認，謝謝。
lines.en: Hi, this is Mark Chen from Bright Electric. I'm calling about the lights you asked us to install in your office. We've received the parts, so we can do the work this Thursday. It should take about three hours. Since we'll need to turn off the power while we work, you might want to let your staff know in advance. Please call me back to confirm. Thanks.
lines.zh-Hans: 你好，我是光亮电气的陈马克。我打来是关于您请我们在办公室安装的灯具。零件已经到了，所以这个星期四可以施工，大约需要三个小时。因为施工时要切断电源，您可能要先通知员工。请回电确认，谢谢。

t: Who most likely is the speaker?
ask.plain: Who most likely is the speaker?
ask.en: Who most likely is the speaker?

explain.zh: 他來自電氣公司，要來「安裝燈具」。
explain.en: He is from an electrical company and will install lights.
explain.zh-Hans: 他来自电气公司，要来「安装灯具」。

t: How long will the work take?
ask.plain: How long will the work take?
ask.en: How long will the work take?

explain.zh: 「大約需要三個小時」。
explain.en: About three hours.
explain.zh-Hans: 「大约需要三个小时」。

t: Why does the speaker suggest telling the staff?
ask.plain: Why does the speaker suggest telling the staff?
ask.zh: 說話者為什麼建議通知員工？
ask.en: Why does the speaker suggest telling the staff?
ask.zh-Hans: 说话者为什么建议通知员工？

t: The power will be turned off.
options.plain: The power will be turned off.

t: The parking lot will be closed.
options.plain: The parking lot will be closed.

explain.zh: 「施工時要切斷電源」。
explain.en: The power will be off during the work.
explain.zh-Hans: 「施工时要切断电源」。

lines.plain: Listen to the following talk.
lines.kana: Listen to the following talk.
lines.zh: 請聽以下談話。
lines.en: Listen to the following talk.
lines.zh-Hans: 请听以下谈话。

t: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Art Museum. My name is Sarah, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about an hour. We'll start in the modern art gallery on the second floor, and then we'll visit the photography exhibition, which only opened last week. Please remember that taking photos with a flash isn't allowed inside the galleries. At the end of the tour, you're welcome to visit the gift shop, where tour members receive ten percent off.
lines.plain: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Art Museum. My name is Sarah, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about an hour. We'll start in the modern art gallery on the second floor, and then we'll visit the photography exhibition, which only opened last week. Please remember that taking photos with a flash isn't allowed inside the galleries. At the end of the tour, you're welcome to visit the gift shop, where tour members receive ten percent off.
lines.kana: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Art Museum. My name is Sarah, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about an hour. We'll start in the modern art gallery on the second floor, and then we'll visit the photography exhibition, which only opened last week. Please remember that taking photos with a flash isn't allowed inside the galleries. At the end of the tour, you're welcome to visit the gift shop, where tour members receive ten percent off.
lines.zh: 大家早安，歡迎來到河畔美術館。我叫莎拉，是今天的導覽員。導覽大約一個小時。我們從二樓的現代藝術展廳開始，接著參觀上週才開幕的攝影展。請記得展廳內不能用閃光燈拍照。導覽結束後歡迎到禮品店逛逛，參加導覽的人可以打九折。
lines.en: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Art Museum. My name is Sarah, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about an hour. We'll start in the modern art gallery on the second floor, and then we'll visit the photography exhibition, which only opened last week. Please remember that taking photos with a flash isn't allowed inside the galleries. At the end of the tour, you're welcome to visit the gift shop, where tour members receive ten percent off.
lines.zh-Hans: 大家早安，欢迎来到河畔美术馆。我叫莎拉，是今天的导览员。导览大约一个小时。我们从二楼的现代艺术展厅开始，接着参观上周才开幕的摄影展。请记得展厅内不能用闪光灯拍照。导览结束后欢迎到礼品店逛逛，参加导览的人可以打九折。

t: Who most likely is the speaker?
ask.plain: Who most likely is the speaker?
ask.en: Who most likely is the speaker?

explain.zh: 「我是今天的導覽員」。
explain.en: She is the guide for the tour.
explain.zh-Hans: 「我是今天的导览员」。

t: What is mentioned about the photography exhibition?
ask.plain: What is mentioned about the photography exhibition?
ask.zh: 關於攝影展，提到了什麼？
ask.en: What is mentioned about the photography exhibition?
ask.zh-Hans: 关于摄影展，提到了什么？

t: It is on the first floor.
options.plain: It is on the first floor.

explain.zh: 攝影展「上週才開幕」。
explain.en: It only opened last week.
explain.zh-Hans: 摄影展「上周才开幕」。

t: What can tour members get at the gift shop?
ask.plain: What can tour members get at the gift shop?
ask.zh: 參加導覽的人在禮品店可以得到什麼？
ask.en: What can tour members get at the gift shop?
ask.zh-Hans: 参加导览的人在礼品店可以得到什么？

explain.zh: 參加導覽的人「可以打九折」。
explain.en: Ten percent off.
explain.zh-Hans: 参加导览的人「可以打九折」。
